_README: 複製成 `presence_music.json` 再改。這一份的預設值是通用的，多數人不用動。presence_probe 每次 probe tick 重讀，不必重啟 bot。整個檔案不存在 ＝ 用程式內建的同一組規則。
_comment: Music-detection rules used by presence_probe. Loaded on every probe tick (~8s default), so edits take effect without restarting the bot.
_smtc_comment: Substrings matched case-insensitive against the SMTC AUMID. Only approved streaming music apps/PWAs belong here; local-file players are deliberately excluded.
_browser_aumid_comment: Substrings identifying a generic browser SMTC source (no per-PWA AUMID). A hit causes presence_probe to fall back to scanning visible window titles via browser_window_hints — needed so YT Music in a normal Edge tab still registers as music without false-positiving on regular YT videos.
_browser_window_hints_comment: Per-entry: window_substring must appear in some visible window title TOGETHER with the SMTC song title. Only then do we promote the browser SMTC to music with the given label.
_foreground_patterns_comment: Regex patterns (Python re) matched against the foreground window title when SMTC returns nothing. Must contain named group 'song'; 'artist' is optional. Anchored matching (use ^ explicitly if needed). Bad regexes are skipped with a stderr warning.
